cmd.help:
Plugin Usage
Join channel: PH_CMD_JOIN
Leave channel: PH_CMD_LEAVE
Create channel: PH_CMD_CREATE
Close channel: PH_CMD_CLOSE
Write <HelloWorld> to default channel: PH_CMD_CHAT_DEFAULT
Write <HelloWorld> to other channel: PH_CMD_CHAT_OTHER
Reset default channel to local: PH_CMD_CHAT_LOCAL
Change chat-override: PH_CMD_OVERRIDE
Change save-database: PH_CMD_SAVE
Show (this) help: PH_CMD_HELP
Show Plugin description: PH_CMD_INFO
Show Plugin status: PH_CMD_STATUS
